detail: Key is read with os.environ.get(SIMFIN_API_KEY); its VALUE is never stored in any variable that is written out.
The key is passed ONLY to the official package's simfin.set_api_key(); it is never placed in a URL, log line, or artifact.
Only api_key_present (a bool) is ever printed - never the key value.
No artifact field contains the key; only the boolean api_key_present.
The simfin bulk cache is written under research/data/simfin/, ignored by * .
research/data/simfin/.gitignore ignores raw/ (and * with a .gitignore allow).
Cache/raw/normalized live under research/data/simfin/, never under the committed research/output/ artifacts directory.
